evals.expected_output: Complete review with dimension analysis, issues found, and actionable recommendations

assertions.name: dimension_analysis_present
assertions.description: Review includes systematic analysis of 8 dimensions
assertions.check: Output contains table or structured list covering all 8 dimensions with status indicators

assertions.name: issues_identified
assertions.description: Review identifies specific issues: omissions, ambiguities, contradictions
assertions.check: Output contains at least one concrete issue with location and recommendation

assertions.name: actionable_recommendations
assertions.description: Recommendations are specific and actionable
assertions.check: Each recommendation specifies what to add/change, where, and provides concrete example

assertions.name: clear_verdict
assertions.description: Review provides final verdict: Approved, Needs Revision, or Blocked
assertions.check: Output ends with explicit verdict statement

assertions.name: project_context_checks
assertions.description: Review considers project-specific context
assertions.check: Output references project architecture, directory structure, or existing systems

evals.prompt: 评审这个设计文档的完备性：docs/superpowers/specs/phase2.5/2026-05-11-dialogui-scroll-style-design.md
evals.expected_output: 批判性评审报告，指出遗漏点、模糊点、矛盾点，给出具体改进建议

assertions.name: critical_review_not_validation
assertions.description: Review is critical, not rubber-stamp validation
assertions.check: Output identifies specific problems or gaps

assertions.name: specific_recommendations_not_generic
assertions.description: Recommendations are concrete, not vague
assertions.check: Each recommendation specifies exact location, issue, and fix

assertions.name: problem_types_identified
assertions.description: Review categorizes issues: 遗漏点, 模糊点, 矛盾点, 待澄清点
assertions.check: Output uses these Chinese terms to categorize findings

assertions.name: chinese_language_handling
assertions.description: Skill handles Chinese prompts correctly
assertions.check: Output is in Chinese or bilingual, maintains critical tone

assertions.name: scoring_or_status_system
assertions.description: Review provides systematic scoring for each dimension
assertions.check: Output includes table showing completeness status

evals.expected_output: Identify missing dimensions and provide specific recommendations

assertions.name: identifies_missing_background
assertions.description: Review identifies Background dimension is missing
assertions.check: Output explicitly states Background is missing

assertions.name: identifies_missing_problem_definition
assertions.description: Review identifies Problem Definition is missing
assertions.check: Output notes Problem Definition missing, 'Goal' is vague substitute

assertions.name: identifies_missing_solution_details
assertions.description: Review identifies Solution lacks technical details
assertions.check: Output notes solution is high-level without implementation details

assertions.name: identifies_missing_boundaries
assertions.description: Review identifies Boundaries not specified
assertions.check: Output notes scope not defined, no constraints mentioned

assertions.name: identifies_missing_validation_criteria
assertions.description: Review identifies Acceptance Criteria missing
assertions.check: Output notes no measurable criteria or test plan

assertions.name: provides_concrete_fix_for_each_missing
assertions.description: Review provides fix for each missing dimension
assertions.check: Each missing dimension has recommendation with example

assertions.name: verdict_needs_revision
assertions.description: Review gives verdict needs revision
assertions.check: Output states verdict as 'Needs Revision' or 'Blocked'

evals.expected_output: Detect contradiction and ask clarifying questions

assertions.name: detects_click_count_contradiction
assertions.description: Review detects contradiction between problem and solution
assertions.check: Output identifies problem says 'reduce clicks' but solution adds complexity

assertions.name: detects_simplification_vs_complexity_contradiction
assertions.description: Review detects simplify vs add features contradiction
assertions.check: Output notes adding features contradicts simplification goal

assertions.name: uses_ask_user_question
assertions.description: Review uses AskUserQuestion to clarify
assertions.check: AskUserQuestion tool was invoked

assertions.name: provides_alternative_approach
assertions.description: Review suggests alternative approach
assertions.check: Recommendation suggests concrete alternative solution

assertions.name: verdict_blocked_or_needs_major_revision
assertions.description: Review gives verdict blocked or major revision
assertions.check: Output states verdict as 'Blocked' or 'Needs Revision'

assertions.name: explains_why_contradiction_matters
assertions.description: Review explains risk of contradiction
assertions.check: Output explains implementing this will fail stated goal
